#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

long long solve(long long r, long long c) {
    if (r < 3 && c < 3) return 0LL;
    if (r == 1) {
        long long m = c % 6;
        return c - min(m, 6 - m);
    }
    if (r == 2) {
        if (c == 3 || c == 7) return 2LL * (c - 1);
        return 2LL * c;
    }
    return (r * c) & ~1LL;
}

int main() {
    long long R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;
    cout << solve(min(R, C), max(R, C)) << endl;
    return 0;
}
